To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the higher-dimensional Einstein vacuum equations with a cosmological constant term Λ are conformally equivalent to fourth-order gravity, that this holds for any dimension m of the internal space, and that this is a consequence of the fact that the warped product of a four-dimensional manifold with a space of constant curvature is an Einstein space.

The higher-dimensional Einstein equation with a Λ-term is conformally equivalent to fourth-order gravity with a cosmological term in four dimensions, which is scale-invariant, i.e., invariant under the conformal group SO(4,2) of Minkowski space.

(a) the higher-dimensional Einstein equation with Λ-term and a warped product metric is conformally equivalent to scale-invariant fourth order gravity, (b) the latter has an attractor property, and (c) the power-law inflation solution of the latter is an attractor of the former.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a general class of models of the type (4 + m)-dimensional Kaluza-Kleinspace-time with a warped product metric.
the question of how the inflationary scenario can be embedded in higher-dimensional theories.
the question of whether the Kaluza theory can be used as a basis for a cosmology.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the power-law solution in the Kaluza- Klein model is an attractor solution, and the same is true for the corresponding solution in fourth-order gravity.
inflation in Kaluza-Kleinspace-time with Λ-term is a consequence of scale-invariant, fourth-order gravity.
the power-law inflation in the Kaluza- Klein model is equivalent to the scale- invariant fourth-order gravity model.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the inflationary solutions in the higher-dimensional vacuum Einstein equation with cosmological constant are attractors in the space of initial data for all m ≥ 4.
inflation in Kaluza-Kleins cosmology is equivalent to fourth-order gravity.
the power-law solution of fourth-order gravity is the attractor of a wide class of cosmologies, including those of Kaluza-Kleins and Brans-Dicke types.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the conformal equivalence between the higher-dimensional Einstein equation with Λ-term and the four-dimensional scale-invariant gravity holds for a general class of warped products between space-time and an internal space of arbitrary dimensions.

the inflationary solution in the higher-dimensional theory has a natural embedding into a four-dimensional theory with a non-minimally coupled scalar field, which is not a scalaron but a dilaton, and a non-trivial cosmological constant.
the inflationary attractor is a generic feature of scale-invariant gravity theories, and not restricted to the Einstein-Hilbert action.
